description: A grey granite Gothic-style temple with multiple spires and a small gold statue on top stands on a dusty plain with mountains behind it. In the foreground, oxen pull a wooden wagon carrying a large white stone block bound with chains, with men in work clothes and wide-brimmed hats guiding them. A small town of wooden and adobe buildings lies to the left under a dramatic cloudy sky at sunset. There is no visible text, frame or border.
